local_filings_dirs._comment: Per-ticker path to a local folder where the user keeps that company's filings/transcripts/announcements. Checked BEFORE any download (workflow step 0.5): read these first, fetch only the gap. Self-populating like default_peer_sets — if a ticker is absent here, ask the user once, then write the confirmed absolute path back. Paths may contain spaces / non-ASCII; always quote in shell. Example: "1810.HK": "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-个人/filings/xiaomi/".

default_peer_sets._comment: Peer groups keyed by ticker, so the skill doesn't re-derive comparables and re-search their filings every run. Self-populating: an EMPTY array [] means 'not set yet' — the skill derives peers, confirms with the user, then writes them back here. A NON-EMPTY array is used as-is (still confirm if stale). Pre-seeded below are the high-frequency names from past runs (≥3 sessions); fill each on its next run. Example: "002050.SZ": ["600690.SH", "002032.SZ"].
